harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured NFS sharing between node1 (server, RHEL 7.9) and node2 (client, RHEL 7.9) using a shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) on both hosts. node1 exports /srv/nfs/shared (owned dataops:dataops, mode 2770) via NFSv4.1 restricted to node2's IP with root_squash; node2 mounts it persistently at /mnt/shared via /etc/fstab. Verified bidirectional writes preserve dataops:dataops ownership and 2770 permissions. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes: captured healthy baselines, rebooted one node at a time via systemctl reboot, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and verified full recovery of the NFS export/mount and data integrity after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed nfs-utils on node1 and node2 via a CentOS-7 vault repo (no subscription-manager repos were enabled)
Created dataops user/group with UID/GID 4500 identically on node1 and node2
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1, set owner dataops:dataops and mode 2770
Configured /etc/exports on node1 to export /srv/nfs/shared to node2's IP (rw,sync,no_subtree_check,root_squash); enabled/started rpcbind and nfs-server; opened firewalld nfs/mountd/rpc-bind services
Enabled rpcbind on node2, created /mnt/shared, added persistent fstab entry, mounted the NFS export (NFSv4.1)
Verified cross-node file creation preserves dataops:dataops ownership and 2770 setgid permissions
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service status, export/mount state, data) on both nodes

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified nfs-server/rpcbind auto-started, export active, data intact, and node2's mount auto-recovered with successful new writes
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified rpcbind active, mount auto-recovered via fstab, and successful new writes with correct ownership
Final consistency check on node1 confirming export directory ownership/mode and all cross-node files intact

evidence.requirement: dataops user/group UID/GID 4500 created identically on node1 and node2
evidence.summary: id dataops on both nodes shows uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops) groups=4500(dataops)

evidence.requirement: /srv/nfs/shared created with dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770 on node1
evidence.summary: stat shows dataops:dataops 2770

evidence.requirement: NFS export configured and active on node1
evidence.summary: exportfs -v shows /srv/nfs/shared exported to node2 IP with rw,root_squash; nfs-server/rpcbind active; firewalld opened for nfs/mountd/rpc-bind

evidence.requirement: NFS mount configured persistently on node2 at /mnt/shared
evidence.summary: fstab entry added and mount -a succeeded; mount output shows nfs4 mount from node1 active on node2

evidence.requirement: Consistent dataops:dataops ownership and 2770 permissions maintained across both systems, files created on either side retain ownership
evidence.summary: root is squashed (permission denied) confirming root_squash active; dataops user successfully writes files; ls on both node1 and node2 shows from_node1.txt and from_node2.txt both owned dataops:dataops

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id 9ed9e820-6949-4971-a6a0-9fda0c2ea7ee captured; nfs-server/rpcbind active; export and directory permissions verified

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged and returned; node unreachable during reboot; new boot_id b130ac74-ab94-49f9-9c89-a466adfe9a0e confirms restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart service and data recovery
evidence.summary: nfs-server/rpcbind active, export re-established, directory permissions intact, prior files present; node2's mount auto-recovered and new write succeeded

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id a8e7c48c-f025-4f14-9fd0-ef6c37642e45 captured; rpcbind active; mount active with correct permissions

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged and returned; node unreachable during reboot; new boot_id 440933a3-c144-4551-b78a-ec9f8d22dfe1 confirms restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart mount and data recovery
evidence.summary: mount auto-recovered via fstab, rpcbind active, all prior files present with correct ownership, new write from node2 succeeded and verified present on node1's export
